questions.stem: What is one reason for establishing public corporations?

options.text: To provide essential services to the public
To reduce government involvement in the economy

questions.explanation: Public corporations are established primarily to provide essential services that may not be profitable for private enterprises, ensuring public welfare.

distractorRationale.a: a: Maximizing profits is not the primary goal of public corporations.
distractorRationale.b: c: Public corporations do not compete with private companies; they serve public interests.
distractorRationale.c: d: Public corporations increase government involvement in the economy.
